triggers.name: new_updated_order
triggers.title: New/updated order
triggers.description: New or updated order in Zuora
triggers.help: Triggers when an order is created or updated in Zuora. Note: The custom fields can't be retrieved when connection is established through Basic authentication type.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Get orders created or updated since given date/time. Leave empty to get orders created or updated one hour ago. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more

triggers.name: new_updated_record
triggers.title: New/updated record
triggers.description: New or updated records in Zuora
triggers.help: Checks for new events every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any standard or custom object, e.g. Account, to fetch the records from.

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Zuora action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Zuora connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_custom_object
actions.title: Create custom record
actions.help: Creates a record in Zuora. This action will work only with OAuth 2.0 authentication type.

actions.name: get_custom_object_record
actions.title: Get custom record
actions.help: Retrieve the details of any custom record via its ID. This action will work only with OAuth 2.0 authentication type.

actions.name: get_object
actions.title: Get record
actions.description: Get record by ID in Zuora
actions.help: Retrieve details of an object by its ID.

actions.name: get_order
actions.title: Get order by order number
actions.description: Get order in Zuora by order number
actions.help: Retrieve details of an order from Zuora by providing order number. Note: The custom fields can't be retrieved when connection is established through Basic authentication type.

input.name: id
input.label: Order number
input.hint: Provide order number. For ex: O-00000059

actions.name: get_subscriptions
actions.title: Get orders by subscription number
actions.description: Get orders by subscription number in Zuora
actions.help: Retrieve details of an order from Zuora by providing subscription number. Note: The custom fields can't be retrieved when connection is established through Basic authentication type.

input.name: id
input.label: Subscription number
input.hint: The number of the subscription to retrieve orders for. For example, A-S00000001

actions.name: query_records
actions.title: Query records
actions.description: Query records using ZOQL in Zuora
actions.help: Query records using ZOQL. The Zuora Object Query Language (ZOQL) is a simple SQL-like query language used to search and filter records in Zuora. Basic knowledge and experience with SQL is required to work with ZOQL. No joins, aggregate functions, wildcards and order by statements are supported in ZO…

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object that should be queried.

input.name: query_string
input.label: ZOQL query
input.hint: The full ZOQL expression that specifies the object to query, the fields to retrieve, and any filters. Find more information here .

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: The size of the query result to be returned. Maximum is 2000.

actions.name: search_records
actions.title: Search records
actions.help: Search will return results that match all your search criteria. A maximum of 200 records will be fetched.

actions.name: update_custom_object
actions.title: Update custom record
actions.help: Updates record in Zuora. This action will work only with OAuth 2.0 authentication type.

actions.name: update_order_triggerdate
actions.title: Update order trigger date
actions.description: Update trigger date for pending order in Zuora
actions.help: Updates the triggering dates for any of the order actions. Learn more .

input.name: id
input.label: Order number
input.hint: Order number of a pending order in which you are to update an order action's triggering dates.

properties.name: sequence
properties.label: Sequence
properties.hint: Identifies which order action will have its triggering dates updated. You can find sequence number from the get order action.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.hint: Name of the trigger date of the order action. Allowed values are ServiceActivation , CustomerAcceptance

properties.name: triggerDate
properties.label: Trigger date
properties.hint: Trigger date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The date you are to set as the service activation date or the customer acceptance date.

properties.name: chargeNumber
properties.label: Charge number
properties.hint: Charge number of the charge which needs the triggering date to be provided.

properties.name: specificTriggerDate
properties.label: Specific trigger date
properties.hint: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The specific trigger date you are to set for the charge.
